title: Optional fields with no value are left off the card
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A work order missing values for some enabled optional fields.
custom_steps:
1. Enable several optional fields.
  2. View a work order missing some of those values.
  3. Confirm the empty optional fields are omitted rather than shown blank.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Optional fields with no value are left out.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10048 — Story 5 Choose what is shown. Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
